evidence.text:
Reason for referral: Evaluation of perioperative cardiovascular risk before planned
elective total knee arthroplasty.
EKG: NSR, LVH by voltage, rate 83, PR 153, QRS 109.

Findings: Normal left ventricular size. Left ventricular ejection fraction estimated at
65%. Mild mitral regurgitation. No pericardial effusion.
Impression: Normal left ventricular systolic function.

LIPIDPANEL
Total Cholesterol: 269 mg/dL (H)
LDL Choesterol: 151 mg/dL (H)
HDL Cholesterol: 69 mg/dL
Triglycerides: 246 mg/dL (H)

BASIC METABOLIC PANEL
Sodium: 134 mmol/L (L)
Potassium:5.2 mmol/L (H)
Chloride: 106 mmol/L
CO2: 28 mmol/L
BUN: 30 mg/dL (H)
Creatinine: 0.7 mg/dL
Glucose: 174 mg/dL (H)
Calcium: 10.1 mg/dL

Lisinopril 10 mg by mouth once daily
Metformin 500 mg by mouth twice daily
Tiotropium 18 mcg by mouth once daily

EXM:
General: well appearing, no distress.
Neck: no jugular venous distension.
Cardiac exam: regular rate and rhythm, normal S1 and S2, soft systolic murmur at the
sternal border, no gallop.
Lungs: clear bilaterally.
Extremities: no peripheral edema.

EXAM:
General: well appearing, no distress.
Neck: no jugular venous distension.
Cardiac exam: regular rate and rhythm, normal S1 and S2, no murmurs or gallops.
Lungs: clear to auscultation bilaterally.
Extremities: trace ankle edema.
